product.title: Private City Tour of Rio de Janeiro

description.text: In Rio de Janeiro, this private 8-hour city tour keeps one group with a dedicated guide for historic downtown, the Sambadrome, and the Metropolitan Cathedral before the Corcovado and Sugar Loaf ascents. The published route includes a Christ the Redeemer stop and lists the Colombo tea house as an own-expense lunch or snack. Hotel or airport pickup and an air-conditioned vehicle are included, with tickets listed on the product page. The format suits visitors who want a guided landmark day without assembling cable-car, van, and downtown timing independently. Commentary stays on the historic center and the two granite peaks rather than a rainforest jeep add-on. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Rio de Janeiro, and the itinerary stays on historic downtown, the Sambadrome, the Metropolitan Cathedral, Corcovado, and Sugar Loaf that shape this private circuit rather than a hang-gliding or helicopter window.
